# Vineberry seeds

Type: Seed | Internal ID: VineberrySeeds | Source: Vineberry Clusters in the, Ashlands | Usage: Farming | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes | Produces: 1, Ashvine, plant | Grow Time (s): 100-200 | Needs Cultivated Ground?: Yes | Space Needed (m): 1 | Hospitable Biomes: Meadows, ,, Black Forest, ,, Swamp, ,, Plains, ,, Mistlands, and, Ashlands

# Introduction

Vineberry seeds can be acquired when harvesting Vineberry clusters from Ashvine. They are used to plant ashvine with a cultivator.
When harvesting Vineberry clusters, there is a 20% chance to produce 1-4 Vineberry seeds.

## Farming

• See Ashvine

## Notes

• Ashvine can produce seeds in any biome.
